name: Strava Clubs

sources.title: Strava sign-up — free account via Google, Apple, or email

requirements: Free personal account — sign up with Google, Apple, or email (email + country fields shown)
Strava is a fitness community; the catalog entry's 'listing' is really a profile or a Club — there is no product-directory submission
Club creation requires an existing account; clubs can be brand-related but are community entities, not listings
preparation: Brand name, logo, and website for a Club profile if creating one
A legitimate fitness/athletic angle — Strava clubs are for sports communities; an unrelated SaaS promo club would be off-norm
workflow: Register free at strava.com/register (Google, Apple, or email + country)
Complete the profile (website field if available)
Create a Club for the brand/product community and set its website/description
Post club content; club pages are public and indexable
watchFor: Poor product-directory fit — this is an athlete community; treat only if the product has a genuine fitness/sport angle
Club creation flow details were not verified (requires logged-in account)
Subscription upsell exists but is not required for signup or clubs
countsAsLive: A public strava.com/clubs/<club-name> page (or profile) rendering the brand description and website link
unknowns: Club creation requirements (account age, activity minimums)
Whether club website links are followed
Whether club creation is restricted to certain club types (e.g., brand vs. local)
